description: This file defines a console command class InstallerCountryListCommand that lists or retrieves specific country identifiers from a predefined list within the OrangeHRM installer module, utilizing Symfony Console components.

classes.name: InstallerCountryListCommand
classes.description: A console command class for listing country options and fetching specific country identifiers based on user input, inheriting from InstallerCommand.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the console command, 'install:country-list'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the 'country' option for the command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command: lists countries or returns the country ID based on the input option.
